app.name: Saans
chat.title: Ask Saans
footer.notMedical: Not medical advice. For a health condition, follow your doctor's advice.
aqi.title: Air right now
aqi.unavailable: Air data is unavailable right now. No reading is shown.
aqi.idle: Enter a place to see its air quality.
plan.title: Your day plan
plan.sensitive: Someone in this household is sensitive to smog, so the advice is more cautious. For any health condition, follow your doctor's advice.
plan.noActivities: Add an activity to see a timed routine.
reason.goAt: The air is expected to be cleaner at that time.
reason.mask: The air is {band} right now, so a mask helps on the way.
reason.maskTomorrow: Tomorrow's air is expected to be {band}.
reason.goAheadTomorrow: Tomorrow's air is expected to be {band}.
reason.moveIndoors: The air is {band}; heavy outdoor activity adds the most smog to your lungs.
reason.stayIndoorsUntil: The air is {band} now and is expected to improve.
lateInDay: It is late in the day, so the plan moves to tomorrow.
tip.airOutUnavailable: Do not air the house today; outdoor air is too polluted.
tip.purifierNight: Run an air purifier at night; the air is {band}.
tip.exhaustCooking: Cook with the kitchen exhaust fan on and the door closed.
tip.noIncense: Avoid incense, mosquito coils and candles; the air is {band}.
swap.metro: Metro trains keep you away from most road traffic exhaust.
swap.bus: A full bus shares its emissions across many riders.
swap.carpool: Sharing one car splits its emissions and exhaust among riders.
swap.walk: Walking emits nothing; on a polluted day keep the walk short.
swap.cycle: Cycling emits nothing; on a polluted day take a quieter route away from traffic.
swap.headline: {toMode} instead of {fromMode} → {smog} · {co2}
chat.welcome: Tell me your city, who is at home (any children or elders) and how you travel today. I will build a low-smog plan.
chat.error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
reply.air: Air in {city} is {band}, AQI {aqi}. Source: CAMS via Open-Meteo, a modelled estimate.
reply.askLocation: Which city or area are you in?
reply.pickCity: I found a few places with that name. Which one do you mean?
reply.notFound: I could not find that place in India. Try a nearby city name.
reply.airUnavailable: I could not get air data right now, so I will not guess. Please try again in a moment.
chip.wfh: What if I work from home?
chip.childPlay: Can my child play outside at 5?
reply.airSensitive: Air in {city} is {band}, AQI {aqi}. Someone at home is sensitive, so I kept the advice cautious; source: CAMS via Open-Meteo, a modelled estimate.
reply.changeCity: To change city, type its name.
reply.assumedCommute: I am assuming a 10 km commute at 9:00.
key.title: Gemini key (optional)
key.label: Your Gemini API key
key.get: Get a free key from Google AI Studio
key.privacy: Your key stays in this browser tab and is sent only to Google. It is forgotten when you close the tab.
key.tooShort: That key looks too short. Please paste the whole key.
notice.keyInvalid: Your Gemini key was not accepted, so it was removed. Add a valid key to use AI again.
notice.quota: Your Gemini key has hit its usage limit. Showing the simple answer instead.
notice.geminiDown: Gemini is not responding right now. Showing the simple answer instead.
notice.rateLimited: You are sending messages quickly, so this answer is the simple one. AI replies resume in a minute.
ack.noOne.0: Got it, no one sensitive at home.
ask.household.0: Is anyone at home sensitive to smog, like a child, an elder or someone with asthma?
ask.household.1: Who is at home? Tell me about any children, elders or people with asthma.
ask.travel.1: How will you get around today?
ask.outdoors.0: Anything outdoors today, like a walk, play or the school run?
ask.outdoors.1: Will anyone be outdoors today, for a stroll, play or school?
dialogue.ready: Your plan is ready. Pick a question below, or tell me what to change.
fu.past: 5 pm has passed today, so I cannot check it.
fu.noForecast: I have no forecast for 5 pm, so I will not guess.
fu.playYes: Yes. At 5 pm the air is expected to be {band}, within the cautious limit for a child (modelled estimate).
fu.playNo: Not at 5 pm. The air is expected to be {band}, above the cautious limit for a child.
fu.playBest: A better time today is {hour}, when the air should be {band}.
fu.playNone: I see no good outdoor window today. For any health concern, follow your doctor's advice.
fu.wfh: Working from home skips the {mode} commute: about {dose} µg less smog inhaled and {co2} kg less CO₂. I updated your plan.
fu.wfhCo2: Working from home skips the {mode} commute: {co2} kg less CO₂. I updated your plan.
fu.wfhNone: Your plan has no commute, so working from home changes nothing.
fu.explain: Air in {city} is {band}: {meaning}. The AQI sits on the CPCB scale of {lo} to {hi}, and the main pollutant is {pollutant}. This is a modelled estimate from CAMS.
explain.good: the air is clean and outdoor time is fine for everyone
explain.satisfactory: the air is acceptable, though very sensitive people may notice it
explain.moderate: sensitive people may feel discomfort, so keep outdoor effort light
explain.poor: most people may feel discomfort outdoors for long
explain.veryPoor: long outdoor time is hard on everyone, so limit it
explain.severe: the air is hazardous, so stay indoors as much as you can
